//: FRAGMENT fixture for the KPI NUMERIC-STRIP ROW sub-component — the `.pa-kpi-strip__row` the kpi-strip container (kpi-strip.json) feeds through its default slot and DEFERS to here. Tested in isolation (svelte `display/KpiStripRow.svelte` → REGISTRY key kpi-strip-row; keen `PureAdmin.Components.KpiStrip.kpi_strip_row/1` → render/2 + meta/1 key kpi-strip-row). GENERALITY NOTE (same model as list-item.json): the row's cells are FLAT SIBLINGS under the `pa-kpi-strip__` block (`pa-kpi-strip__metric`/`__now`/`__num`/`__unit`/`__prev`/`__delta`/`__target`/`__bar`/`__fill`/`__bar-pct`), NOT sub-elements of `pa-kpi-strip__row`. So block=`pa-kpi-strip__row` gives a VACUOUS reverse scope (no `pa-kpi-strip__row--*`/`pa-kpi-strip__row__*` selectors exist) — but the base class `pa-kpi-strip__row` DOES exist in main.css, so no vacuous-scope note. The sibling cells are claimed via each feature's `produces` (forward-verified against main.css) and exercised by the goldens; capability's reverse checks (scoped to pa-kpi-strip__row--/__ ) are correctly empty. The container (kpi-strip.json) OWNS `__body`/`__head-row`/`__head`(+`--num`/`--prev`/`--delta`/`--target`) — those are NOT part of this row fragment. The bare `__delta` renders the positive colour; `__delta--*` are the five sentiment variants. `__fill` carries an INLINE width (style='width: N%'), never a class — both wrappers emit the identical `width: N%` value (keen `width: #{capped||0}%`, svelte `width: {capped ?? 0}%`). Authored from snippets/kpi.html (NUMERIC STRIP section, L648-672) + _kpi-numeric-strip.scss.
goldenConventions: Row element is a <div class="pa-kpi-strip__row"> (hover host for the detail popover; the popover itself is JS-relocated and not SSR-material here when no detail is set). Cell order is fixed: metric, now, (prev), delta, target. The metric/now/delta/target cells ALWAYS render; the prev cell renders ONLY when previousValueText is set (both wrappers guard it). Inside __now: an optional __unit prefix, then __num, then an optional __unit suffix — __num always renders when valueText is set (keen guards __num on value_text, svelte renders it unconditionally, so every scenario here sets valueText to keep the two shells identical). The target cell always holds __bar > __fill (inline width), plus __bar-pct ONLY when targetPercentText is set. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

propsVocabulary.metric: metric-name cell text — pa-kpi-strip__metric. svelte metricText; keen metric_text.
propsVocabulary.value: focal 'now' number — the pa-kpi-strip__num inside pa-kpi-strip__now. svelte valueText; keen value_text.
propsVocabulary.unit: unit suffix after the number — pa-kpi-strip__unit (second affix inside __now). svelte unit; keen unit_text.
propsVocabulary.prefix: currency/scale prefix before the number — pa-kpi-strip__unit (first affix inside __now). svelte prefix; keen prefix_text.
propsVocabulary.prev: previous-period value — pa-kpi-strip__prev (cell omitted when unset). svelte previousValueText; keen previous_value_text.
propsVocabulary.delta: Δ% text — pa-kpi-strip__delta. svelte deltaText; keen delta_text.
propsVocabulary.deltaVariant: Δ% sentiment — pa-kpi-strip__delta--{variant}. svelte deltaVariant; keen delta_variant.
propsVocabulary.targetBarPercent: target bar fill width % (0-100, visually capped) — inline style on pa-kpi-strip__fill. svelte targetBarPercent; keen target_bar_percent.
propsVocabulary.targetPercent: percent label below the target bar — pa-kpi-strip__bar-pct (may exceed 100). svelte targetPercentText; keen target_percent_text.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the row (passthrough — svelte class, keen class).

features.//: Feature->class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-kpi-strip__'). The row's cells are flat siblings under pa-kpi-strip__ claimed via produces + exercised by goldens. deltaVariant's five options map to the blessed sentiment suffixes (--positive/--negative/--neutral/--up-strong/--down-strong). metric/value/prev/delta text slots carry no modifier. unit/prefix both land in pa-kpi-strip__unit (the same affix class, before/after __num). targetBarPercent sets the INLINE width on __fill (produces:null — structural, no class). targetPercent produces the __bar-pct label element. __now/__target/__bar/__fill are structural wrappers always present (exercised by goldens).

targetBarPercent.note: structural — sets the INLINE width on pa-kpi-strip__fill (style='width: N%'), never a class

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim to the row, not a core feature
